facts.text: John was able to jog without pain on Last Friday.

evidence.quote: Last Friday, I had a milestone moment at the gym. I was able to jog a bit with no pain, which was such a relief!

facts.text: John hosted a small get-together with friends and family to celebrate his milestone.

evidence.quote: My wife and I hosted a small get-together with friends and family to celebrate.

facts.text: John expressed appreciation for Tim's support and encouragement.

evidence.quote: Thanks! Appreciate the support and encouragement.
